style: Design Studio for FastLED lighting-console identity: dark precision panels, large approachable technical typography, restrained node graph, and one cyan-to-purple-to-magenta signal pulse

customize.reuse: Borrow the block's large editorial hierarchy and deterministic GSAP entrance timing.
handAuthoredGaps: variable-driven title, end, and series-complete modes

layout.title: left column, 108px Audiowide, maximum two lines, 1040px wide
layout.nodeGraph: right third, three simplified panels connected left-to-right

scenes.text: Variable-driven tutorial title or next-card copy
scenes.motion: signal path draws from left to right, a pulse travels into the output node, LED pixels illuminate, then metadata and title resolve into a stable hold

motion.dominantMotif: One signal pulse travels left-to-right through the node path and illuminates the destination matrix.

timeline.action: faint grid, structural rules, and node panels fade into the dark workspace
signal path draws from the first cyan port toward the purple show node
bright pulse travels along the completed path
magenta output node and LED matrix illuminate
series metadata resolves from the left
hero title resolves with a short upward movement and opacity fade
supporting line and progress rail resolve
one restrained LED shimmer keeps the resolved frame gently alive without moving the typography
a second restrained LED shimmer leads into the clean final hold

motion.hold: All copy and primary geometry remain completely stable from 1.72s through 4.0s.

modes.title: BEGINNER SERIES / TUTORIAL NN, hero title, supporting line, current progress square magenta
modes.end: NEXT UP, next tutorial number and title, completed progress squares cyan and next square magenta
modes.complete: SERIES COMPLETE, YOU'RE READY TO BUILD, Create, preview, and perform with Design Studio for FastLED.

motifVariants.juggle: three cyan pixel orbs crossing inside the pattern node
motifVariants.audio: one lime audio pulse entering a cyan frame path
motifVariants.group: three small node tiles collapsing into one Group panel
motifVariants.percussion: three lime trigger ticks entering a cyan shockwave node
motifVariants.generative: two Group tiles entering a purple Show Engine node
motifVariants.music: a short waveform entering Performance Generator
motifVariants.sd: signal path terminating in a small SD-card glyph
motifVariants.compare: one path splitting toward Show Engine and SD playback
motifVariants.hardware: magenta Matrix Output feeding the LED matrix
motifVariants.save: three thin-line file, link, and help glyphs

content.brief: A reusable title-and-end-card system. The hero frame is left-anchored typography balanced by a simplified node graph on the right. The official pixel lockup sits in the upper-left. A single signal pulse is the dominant motion motif; it travels through cyan and purple ports into a magenta output and lights a compact LED matrix. Opening cards resolve to a tutorial title. End cards resolve to NEXT UP, the following tutorial title, and an eleven-pixel progress rail. The final card resolves to SERIES COMPLETE.
